name: Linux PC over local wireless
description: Joins the Civ VII wireless lobby with a Wi-Fi radio and streams the save over LDN UDP :9027.

requirements.os: Linux with NetworkManager and one nl80211 Wi-Fi radio (WSL is not supported)
requirements.keys: prod.keys with aes_kek_generation_source, aes_key_generation_source, master_key_00, master_key_12

networkImpact.releases: only the selected Wi-Fi radio; NetworkManager keeps it unmanaged for the run
networkImpact.restores: the saved profile, its link state and its managed flag

notes: The persistent save is installed; close Civ VII, reopen it and Load Game to run CivSwitchFS and kaiHEN.
The temporary interface is civ7-autoloader-ldn and is removed through netlink on exit.
